title: Dossier catalog and new-dossier creation in ANDS Studio
walkthrough:
You land on a page with a top bar reading "ANDS Studio · dossier manager", then a user chip and navigation chips: "Help", "Portfolio", "Registry", "Correspondence", and "Guided journey →". The user chip shows your email and, next to it, your workspace name (from your server account record); it links to the "Account & security (workspace, MFA)" page, with a "Sign out" button beside it.

Below, the heading "Your product dossiers" sits beside two buttons: "View archived (trash)" and "New dossier +". An explanatory paragraph states that a Dossier ID "is the permanent file for one product at Health Canada", that opening a dossier lets you build its eCTD Module 1–5, and that your workspace's data is isolated from other clients. Several terms (Dossier ID, eCTD, Module 1, REP, CESG, CS-BE) carry glossary tooltips.

If you have no dossiers, a notice says "No dossiers yet. Create one to start building a submission." (While the list fetches you briefly see "Loading dossiers…".)

Clicking "New dossier +" (button toggles to "Cancel") opens an inline card with two fields: "Dossier ID" (placeholder "e123456") and "Product name" (placeholder "Drugazole 10 mg tablet"). Small print explains: "Health Canada issues your Dossier ID when you file a Dossier ID Request through REP (via your CESG account)." with a "You can set the real ID any time; validation reminds you before filing." note. A link-style button offers "No ID yet? Start with a placeholder →", which auto-fills a generated ID starting with "d" plus six digits. You press "Create & open →" (shows "Creating…" while busy). An invalid ID shows a red notice: "Dossier ID must be one letter + 6–7 digits (e.g. e123456)". On success you go straight into the dossier's Module 1 workspace.

Each dossier appears as a clickable tile in a grid: its ID, product title, a meta line combining its submission type with "CS-BE", a progress bar, and a status chip ("Ready to file" or a count like "3/5 modules"). Placeholder dossiers carry a "draft ID — set real ✎" chip. Each tile has a small "✕" delete button.

Clicking delete opens an in-app modal "Delete this dossier?" explaining the dossier is not destroyed but moved to the archive (trash) where it can be restored, with the action recorded on the append-only audit trail; you must type the Dossier ID to confirm and enter a required reason before "Archive dossier" enables. The rename chip opens a "Set the real Health Canada Dossier ID" modal with a new-ID field and optional reason. "View archived (trash)" reveals an "Archived (recoverable)" list where each entry shows when and by whom it was archived, plus a "Restore ↩" button.
